CJ ENM operates major subsidiaries across media, film, music, and global production, including the US studio Fifth Season (formerly Endeavor Content), the streaming platform TVING, the music label and agency WakeOne, and the film division CJ ENM Films & Television. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CJ_ENM_Films_%26_Television)

- **Fifth Season:** Global studio handling premium film and television production.

- **TVING:** Major South Korean streaming and over-the-top (OTT) platform co-owned by CJ ENM.

- **Studio Dragon:** High-profile drama production house under the CJ ENM umbrella. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Media_conglomerate)

### Music and Entertainment

- **WakeOne:** Label and talent management home to acts like Zerobaseone and Kep1er.

- **Mnet:** Influential music and entertainment television channel.

- **Stone Music Entertainment:** Music distribution and investment arm. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WakeOne)

### Film and Live Events

- **CJ ENM Films & Television:** Film investor, producer, and distributor (formerly CJ Entertainment).

- **CJ LiveCity:** Live entertainment infrastructure developer. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CJ_ENM_Films_%26_Television)
